{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.06

|arg= global

|gr1= Animations

|descr= Returns the name of a unit's current gesture. Seems to be forced to lower case in {{arma3}}.
{{Feature|informative|This command is only for a man unit, other units such as animals cannot use this command.}}

|mp= When executed on a client, this command only returns accurate results when the target unit is within sight of the client. When executed on a dedicated server, the returned value is accurate.

|s1= [[gestureState]] unitName

|p1= unitName: [[Object]]

|r1= [[String]] - empty string if not available

|x1= <sqf>private _state = gestureState player;</sqf>

|seealso= [[switchAction]] [[playAction]] [[BIS_fnc_ambientAnimGetParams]] [[animationState]] [[getUnitMovesInfo]]
